name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Rest your upper back across the edge of a sturdy bench with one foot planted flat and the opposite knee lifted toward your chest.
Tuck your chin lightly, brace your abs, and keep your pelvis level from side to side.
Drive firmly through your planted heel to extend your working hip until your thigh and torso form a straight line.
Lower your hips smoothly under control toward the floor, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep both hip bones level at the top without letting the lifted side drop downward.
Position your standing foot so your shin stands roughly vertical at full hip extension.
